messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — product wants to deprecate the legacy `X-Rd-Route` header from public SDKs next quarter to simplify routing policy handling. Need SDK owners + console folks to align on telemetry & quota attribution before we cut.
aj: Uh — breaking change? Do we have a shim plan? How will server still map old traffic to proper quotas/route policies when clients haven't upgraded?
chris: We should be able to support a server-side fallback for 3 months, but console maps need to record both `X-Rd-Route` and new `Rd-Route-V2` for a transition window. That means telemetry schema bump (small) and a migration job for historical attribution.
sasha: I can draft the migration docs and client-side code snippets. For SDK releases: suggest language-specific grace windows and opt-in flag. Example snippet:
```
# python
client = Redwood(api_key=KEY, enable_route_v2=True)
```
leo: devex-bot: canary tests for py-sdk show one flaky test on header parsing (py-headers-test) — looks like edgecase when header is missing. cc @aj
aj: Thanks @leo — I'll take a look. Suggestion: add tolerant parsing + explicit deprecation warning in logs for one minor release before removing.
chris: For the console, we need a tile in the routing dashboard showing % traffic still using legacy header per tenant. That drives outreach and quota corrections.
maria: Agree. Proposal: timeline — week 0 announce, week 2 SDK opt-in patch with warnings, week 6 server-side fallback removal dry-run, week 12 hard remove. SDK owners to publish migration guide + changelog notes by week 1.
sasha: I'll put a draft in the docs repo today and open a PR for the py/ts snippets. Want to sync with platform on telemetry field name: `route_header_version`? cc @chris
chris: `route_header_version` works. Add `route_header_source` to indicate client vs server-translated. Keeps attribution deterministic.
aj: I'll add a small parsing helper to the Go/TS libs and include a deprecation logger. Plan to cut opt-in minor next week.
maria: Great — can we get owners to comment in this thread with ack + ETA? I'll schedule a short sync if needed. :thumbsup:
devex-bot: reminder set for 3 days — follow up on PRs and canary results.
